baseAbsence.semanticBoundary: The base article-open path has no reading-challenge store, streak persistence, or widget state surface.

facts: Default active dates are 2026-05-11 through 2026-06-18 inclusive.
A gap greater than one day resets an incomplete streak during the active window.
After the end date, a broken streak cannot restart; an active streak may continue until removal.
A qualifying read persists the date and increment before widget and analytics effects.

coveredFacts: post-end active and broken streak behavior
